sender.ms: Iklan media sosial, “kawan” atau tawaran kerja yang menawarkan wang untuk meminjam atau menyewa akaun bank anda
sender.en: A social media ad, a “friend” or a job offer paying you to lend or rent out your bank account

name.ms: Tawaran sewa akaun atau kad bank: anda menjadi “keldai akaun”
name.en: Offer to rent your bank account or card: you become a “money mule”

how.ms: Anda ditawarkan bayaran mudah untuk “meminjamkan”, “berkongsi” atau “menyewakan” akaun bank, kad ATM atau akses perbankan dalam talian, kononnya untuk urusan perniagaan atau terima bayaran. Akaun itu sebenarnya digunakan sindiket untuk menerima dan memindahkan wang yang dicuri daripada mangsa penipuan. Pemilik akaun boleh ditangkap dan didakwa di bawah Seksyen 424B dan 424C Kanun Keseksaan, dengan penjara sehingga 10 tahun dan denda sehingga RM150,000. Polis mengenal pasti 39,006 akaun keldai dari Januari hingga Julai 2025.
how.en: You are offered easy money to “lend”, “share” or “rent out” your bank account, ATM card or online banking access, supposedly for business or to receive payments. The account is really used by syndicates to receive and move money stolen from scam victims. The account holder can be arrested and charged under Sections 424B and 424C of the Penal Code, with up to 10 years in prison and a fine of up to RM150,000. Police identified 39,006 mule accounts from January to July 2025.

text.ms: Tawaran wang mudah untuk menggunakan akaun atau kad bank anda.
text.en: An offer of easy money for the use of your bank account or card.

text.ms: Anda diminta menyerahkan kad ATM, nombor PIN atau akses perbankan dalam talian.
text.en: You are asked to hand over your ATM card, PIN or online banking access.

text.ms: Akaun anda menerima wang curi daripada mangsa penipuan dan dipindahkan keluar.
text.en: Your account receives stolen money from scam victims and it is moved out.

text.ms: Akaun anda dibekukan dan anda disiasat polis.
text.en: Your account is frozen and you are investigated by the police.

text.ms: Nak duit cepat? Sewa akaun bank korang RM300 seminggu, tak perlu buat apa-apa, cuma serahkan kad ATM dan PIN. Akaun baru buka pun boleh. Selamat 100%, PM saya.
text.en: Want quick money? Rent out your bank account for RM300 a week, you don't have to do anything, just hand over your ATM card and PIN. Newly opened accounts are fine too. 100% safe, PM me.

ms: tawaran sewa akaun bank dapat duit seminggu
kawan pinjam kad atm dan pin saya
akaun saya dibekukan sebab terima duit orang lain
kerja terima bayaran guna akaun sendiri
polis kata akaun saya akaun keldai
en: offer to rent out my bank account for weekly money
a friend borrowed my atm card and pin
my account was frozen because it received other people's money
job receiving payments into my own account
police said my account was a mule account

ms: Bayaran untuk “meminjam” atau “menyewa” akaun bank atau kad anda.
Diminta menyerahkan kad ATM, PIN, TAC atau akses perbankan dalam talian.
“Kerja” yang hanya menerima dan memindahkan wang orang lain melalui akaun anda.
en: Payment to “borrow” or “rent” your bank account or card.
Being asked to hand over your ATM card, PIN, TAC or online banking access.
A “job” that only receives and forwards other people's money through your account.

ms: Jangan sekali-kali meminjamkan, menjual atau menyewakan akaun atau kad bank anda.
Jika anda sudah menyerahkannya, hubungi bank anda segera untuk menyekat akaun dan tukar semua kata laluan.
en: Never lend, sell or rent out your bank account or card.
If you have already handed it over, call your bank straight away to block the account and change all your passwords.
Report the offer to the police.
